card.name: Start of 'patient' split into pieces
card.fires_on: The odd piece 'p' or '-p' that begins a split-up spelling of 'patient' or 'pediatric', as in 'inter-patient' or all-caps 'PULMONARY' and 'PEDIATRIC'. The word 'patient' itself follows right after.

modes.label: inter-patient variability
modes.description: The '-p' piece after 'inter' just before 'atient' in 'inter-patient variability'.
modes.example: there is inter<<-p>>atient variability in the potency of opioid drugs

modes.label: All-caps warning headings
modes.description: A lone capital 'P' starting a word in an all-caps warning heading, right before 'patients' or a patient group.
modes.example: DYSRHYTHMIAS, CARDIAC ARREST, AND DEATH FROM HYPERKALEMIC RHABDOMYOLYSIS IN<< P>>EDIATRIC PATIENTS Acute

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'patient' in many forms and languages, so the pole fires where 'patient' is already being spelled out in pieces.
card.plain: It marks the first letter chunk of a broken-up word like 'inter-patient' or 'PEDIATRIC', where the next piece completes it.
